title: stare.pub reporter map, format 1
description: stare.pub/reporters.json: every reporter slug the index files volumes under, the abbreviations citare reads as each, the volumes the index held when the site was built, and URL templates for the index and case files. `stare-site export-reporters` generates it from the citare data bundle and the index manifest (crates/stare/src/reporters.rs). The live manifest at idx.stare.pub/manifest.json stays the authority on which volumes are held.

license.description: The licence the reporter map is published under, and stare.pub as its source: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 for everything in it but the fields `sources` names, which carry their source's own licence and notice.

source.description: Where the file comes from: https://stare.pub, the authoritative copy.

sources.description: Every source of the map's names, variations and editions, one entry each, with the commit used, its licence, what it contributes and the fields it contributes to. reporters-db (Free Law Project) is the source of most of them, under its BSD 2-Clause licence, with its LICENSE file and copyright line. citare (Codex Publicus) is the source of the rest, from its own supplement to reporters-db (data/reporters-local.json), under the project's terms, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 with stare.pub as the source. Rows don't say which source they come from.

citare_data.description: The citare data bundle the names and variations came from; the site serves it gzipped at /data/citare/v1/<name>.gz.

reporters_db_commit.description: The reporters-db commit the bundle was built from.

index_build.description: The index manifest the volumes came from, or null when the map was built without one.

urls.description: URL templates. {base} is the live manifest's `base` (v/<version>/); {slug} is a key of `reporters`; {volume} a volume as cited; {folder} the volume folder an index line names (the volume, or a split part such as 138-2); {ref} the case file an index line names; {part} an index part number from the `#parts` header.

abbreviations.description: Every edition name and variation citare knows for a case reporter, exactly as written, mapped to the slugs it can be filed under. Most have one; a name several reporters share (Hill) has several, and citare picks among them by the volume and the citing text.

reporters.description: Slug to what it holds and how it is cited. Lists every slug citare assigns and every slug the index holds, and, for one site release after citare stops assigning a slug, that slug with `replaced_by`.

names.description: The canonical abbreviations of the editions filed under this slug (A.2d). Empty for a slug the index holds that citare has no edition for, and for a replaced slug.

variations.description: Other spellings citare reads as one of `names` (A. 2d).

reporter.description: The reporter's full name in reporters-db.

end_year.description: null for a reporter still publishing or one with no end date in reporters-db.

cap.description: Whether this is the Caselaw Access Project's slug for the reporter, the folder CAP filed its volumes under.

volumes.description: The volume folders the index held at build time, or null when it held none: a citation into the reporter then has no case on stare.pub.

split.description: Volume numbers whose cases CAP split over several folders (138 is 138 and 138-2); the manifest's `parts` gives each folder's pages.

replaced_by.description: Present only on a slug citare no longer assigns: the slug its editions are filed under now (p-r-r is replaced by pr, cai-r by cai, since citare v0.7.2). The entry has no names, variations or editions, no abbreviation maps to it, and it is kept for one site release, then removed.

commit.description: The source's commit: for an upstream, the one the citare data bundle was built from, as the bundle records it (the same as generated_from.reporters_db_commit for reporters-db); for citare, the one stare was built with. null when it isn't recorded.

license.description: An upstream's licence, with its LICENSE file in `text`, or the project's own, CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 with stare.pub as the `source`, the same shape as the file's `license`.

id.description: The SPDX identifier the upstream declares (BSD-2-Clause).

text.description: The upstream's LICENSE file at that commit, verbatim: the copyright notice, the licence's conditions and its disclaimer.

source.description: Where the data comes from: https://stare.pub, the authoritative copy.

copyright.description: The copyright line of an upstream's LICENSE file; present when `license` has `text`.

contributes.description: What the source contributes to the file, in prose.

fields.description: The fields of this file the source contributes to; several sources can contribute to one field. `abbreviations (keys)` is the names of `abbreviations`, not the slugs they map to; `reporters.*.names` is every reporter's `names`.
